items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: Oh yes, I knew him very well.

ctx.x: I think Davey Tuff was there. Gene Cooper was at University High. Tash was at Austin. Jimmy and Rich were both at Austin. And Bud.
Well, we have of an earlier generation, Art Grunemal. He was a piano player.
Oh yes, I knew him very well.
